method: Built-in image_gen generation with Border Collie and DNAture dog/cat portrait style references, followed by framing refinement; converted into native SVG paths with vtracer 0.6.15 via scripts/trace-walking-artwork.py.
refinement_prompt: Refine this exact generic domestic shorthair tabby cat engraving for clean asset framing. Preserve this cat's identity, anatomy, natural four-legged standing pose facing right, gently turned head, upright ears, full curved tail, fur stripes, expression, mint-and-ink engraving treatment and fine detail. Keep ONLY ONE cat. Change framing: make the entire cat smaller on the SQUARE canvas so it occupies at most 80% of canvas width and height, centered, with generous completely transparent empty margins on ALL FOUR SIDES. All whiskers must be fully drawn and visible with at least 8% empty margin BEYOND THEIR TIPS on the right; do not crop whiskers, ears, tail or paws. Genuine alpha transparency immediately outside silhouette, between legs and whiskers; no backdrop, no glow, no halo, no haze, no colored fringe, no floor or shadow. Crisp tapered engraved strokes and airy hatching in EXACT luminous mint #8FE4D9 and deep ink teal #092F39 only, opaque mint inside cat, restrained dark shadows and open mint highlights. Do not add text, logos, props, border, collar, colors, extra animals or change the cat's pose. Entire clean transparent reusable cutout with ample breathing room.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone GENERIC MIXED-BREED DOMESTIC SHORTHAIR CAT (gato mestizo, no pedigree) in the established DNAture mint-and-ink animal engraving graphic line. Input image 1, the Border Collie, is ONLY the graphic-line, palette, full-body standing presentation and engraving-density reference, NOT anatomy. Input image 2, the dog-and-cat portrait, is ONLY an additional feline facial-detail and engraving-style reference; create no dog, no pair, no portrait crop. Subject: a realistic healthy ordinary adult mixed-breed domestic short-haired cat standing naturally on all FOUR legs facing RIGHT, body in side profile and head gently turned three-quarter toward the viewer. Familiar neighborhood companion cat, balanced lean well-nourished feline anatomy, flexible medium body, gently level back, normal leg length, four distinct small soft paws, natural rounded wedge-shaped head, medium upright triangular ears, attentive almond-shaped feline eyes with natural vertical pupils, small triangular nose, delicate muzzle and intact fine whiskers. Calm curious gentle expression, relaxed closed mouth, no human smile. Natural short slightly textured coat, subtle irregular tabby-like markings rendered through engraving density in the SAME TWO inks, not a pedigree Bengal or exotic spotted cat. Long slender natural tail rising in a relaxed gentle curve behind the body with a softly curved tip, fully visible. No exaggerated Persian flat face, folded ears, hairless skin, gigantic Maine Coon coat or tiny kitten proportions. Match image 1's crisp tapered engraved fur strokes following anatomy, airy crosshatching, restrained dark shadows, open flat mint highlights and clean silhouette, with image 2's fine feline whiskers and clear natural eyes. EXACTLY TWO opaque interior colors: luminous mint #8FE4D9 and deep cool ink teal #092F39. Mint-dominant readable drawing, no large featureless dark masses. Square canvas with comfortable genuinely transparent margins around both ears, all whisker tips, full tail and all paws. Entire cat uncropped, plausible feline anatomy, four clearly distinct paws. Genuine alpha transparency immediately outside crisp fur silhouette, including under belly, between legs and between whiskers; opaque mint inside animal. No background, floor, printed checkerboard, ground shadow, halo, glow, haze, gradients, blur, photographic texture, cartoon, 3D, text, watermark, frame, collar, clothing, props, dog or extra animals. No white, black, brown, orange, cream, sepia or warm colors. A reusable clean transparent cutout engraving matching the DNAture animal series.
